title: Sparkly treasure chest
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff28a' stop-opacity='0.95'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#fff28a' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- glow behind chest -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='34' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- chest body -->
  <rect x='24' y='52' width='52' height='30' rx='4' fill='#b56b2e'/>
  <rect x='24' y='52' width='52' height='8' rx='3' fill='#d98d45'/>
  <!-- wood plank lines -->
  <rect x='24' y='66' width='52' height='2' fill='#8f4f20'/>
  <rect x='24' y='74' width='52' height='2' fill='#8f4f20'/>
  <!-- lid -->
  <path d='M24 52 Q24 34 50 34 Q76 34 76 52 Z' fill='#c97a35'/>
  <path d='M24 52 Q24 34 50 34 Q76 34 76 52' fill='none' stroke='#e6a25c' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- lid band -->
  <rect x='24' y='44' width='52' height='5' fill='#8f4f20' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- gold bands -->
  <rect x='30' y='34' width='6' height='48' fill='#ffd83d'/>
  <rect x='64' y='34' width='6' height='48' fill='#ffd83d'/>
  <rect x='30' y='52' width='6' height='10' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <rect x='64' y='52' width='6' height='10' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <!-- gold trim bands on lid -->
  <path d='M30 52 Q30 37 50 37 Q70 37 70 52' fill='none' stroke='#ffd83d' stroke-width='4'/>
  <!-- lock -->
  <rect x='44' y='54' width='12' height='14' rx='2' fill='#ffd83d'/>
  <rect x='44' y='54' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#8f4f20'/>
  <rect x='49' y='63' width='2' height='4' fill='#8f4f20'/>
  <!-- coins spilling -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='82' r='4' fill='#ffd83d'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='82' r='4' fill='none' stroke='#ffe98a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='84' r='4' fill='#ffd83d'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='84' r='4' fill='none' stroke='#ffe98a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='83' r='4' fill='#ffd83d'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='83' r='4' fill='none' stroke='#ffe98a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff7c2'>
    <path d='M14 30 l2 6 l6 2 l-6 2 l-2 6 l-2 -6 l-6 -2 l6 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M86 26 l1.5 4.5 l4.5 1.5 l-4.5 1.5 l-1.5 4.5 l-1.5 -4.5 l-4.5 -1.5 l4.5 -1.5 z'/>
    <path d='M84 62 l1.5 4.5 l4.5 1.5 l-4.5 1.5 l-1.5 4.5 l-1.5 -4.5 l-4.5 -1.5 l4.5 -1.5 z'/>
    <path d='M18 66 l1.5 4.5 l4.5 1.5 l-4.5 1.5 l-1.5 4.5 l-1.5 -4.5 l-4.5 -1.5 l4.5 -1.5 z'/>
    <path d='M50 20 l1.5 4.5 l4.5 1.5 l-4.5 1.5 l-1.5 4.5 l-1.5 -4.5 l-4.5 -1.5 l4.5 -1.5 z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ffe98a'>
    <circle cx='22' cy='42' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='46' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='72' cy='18' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='26' cy='88' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='88' r='2'/>
  </g>
</svg>
